1) Background / Context

The project involves developing a predictive analytics system to estimate "Forest area (% of land area)" for 247 countries in 2012. The estimation is based on historical data ranging from 1960 to 2011. The data is stored in a structured database format.

2) Objectives

- Accurately predict the percentage of forest area for each specified country in 2012.
- Utilize historical data from 1960 to 2011 for prediction.

3) Stakeholders & Users

- Environmental analysts who will use the predictions for research and policy-making.
- Data scientists responsible for developing and refining the prediction model.
- Government agencies interested in monitoring and managing forest resources.

4) Functional Descriptions

- Extract and preprocess historical data from the database.
- Develop a predictive model using machine learning techniques to estimate 2012 forest area percentages based on past data.
- Validate and evaluate the model's accuracy with appropriate metrics.
- Provide a user interface for analysts to access predictions and assess data.

5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Ensure data security and integrity throughout the data processing pipeline.
- Design the system to handle up to 500 concurrent users querying the predictions.
- Deliver predictions with a latency of no more than 2 seconds per request.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0101
CREATE TABLE `countries` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`forest_area` int(11) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `historical_data` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`country_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`year` int(11) NOT NULL,
`forest_area` int(11) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`country_id`) REFERENCES `countries` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`country_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`year` int(11) NOT NULL,
`forest_area` int(11) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`country_id`) REFERENCES `countries` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_roles` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`role` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`user_role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`permission` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`user_role_id`) REFERENCES `user_roles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_history` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_comments` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`comment` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_ratings` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`rating` int(11) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_reviews` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`review` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_feedback` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`feedback` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_suggestions` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`suggestion` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_corrections` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`correction` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `predictions_improvements` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`prediction_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
`improvement` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
`timestamp` datetime NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
FOREIGN KEY (`prediction_id`) REFERENCES `predictions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
